content.short: Flagship Crypto uses AI agents to scan crypto markets and surface trading alpha for users.
content.description: Flagship Crypto is an AI-powered market intelligence product. Its site describes AI agents that scan crypto markets around the clock so users can find trade ideas earlier and act with less manual research. The listing is relevant to TON users as a market and trading-intelligence tool, not as a staking protocol. Trade Alpha before the Market - Our AI-Agents scan crypto markets 24/7 so you can trade like an insider with zero effort. Flagship Crypto gives TON users a practical path to deploy capital, route trades, manage liquidity, or interact with DeFi positions.
